Loosing for Aging and Premenopause Now. This is my third time using weight watchers. The first two were after pregnancies, and this third is to lose premenopausal weight and to get back on the habits of healthy eating that helped me the other two times in my life. 
This is the most practical, on the go, user-friendly way I have found that always helps me focus back of good watching habits and portion control. I’ve dropped a total so far of the fifteen. Premenopausal weight I put on, and the extra 5 pounds I’ve put on over the years of complacent eating habits. 
I love it. I can’t recommend it enough!

Good Tool for Weight Watchers. The Weight Watchers app is an essential tool for my Weight Watcher program participation. One criticism of the app is that some of the foods in the database seem to have incorrect values. Four instance, "breakfast burrito" yields point values anywhere from 10 to 50 points. The app engineers should more carefully edit the food database. On the other hand the barcode scanner works superbly and is my preferred method for entering foods. I would also suggest that the app provide a way of tracking the amount of water consumed each day.

Love WW and the app. I love WW and the app, I began my 35 pound weight loss journey in March of 2022. I had just retired and thought, now is the time. I had the weight off by September of that same year and I have kept it off. The app makes planning and maintaining so easy. I really could not imagine not using the app!! So happy with WW and the plan. My weight, started creeping back up a little and I had not changed anything. Contacted the coaching staff at WW and they told me what to do, my weight has returned to normal. The WW program is the best most healthy option out. Any life style, any age, they know what they are doing. The app is a wonderful part of this amazing program.❤️

Excellent App. Once you navigate thru and familiarize yourself with updated app, you realize how thorough each section is. Easy to follow your progress with daily point system, as well as weight checks, workouts, water intake, nutrition, sleep habits, and many other good health features, to include recipes and exercise tips. Love the updated app!
Easy to use. This upgraded app is a lot easier to use and it more accurate and fast in speed. I’m loving it.

Couldn’t do WW without it!. I love the app! I’ve been a member for 24 years, and having the app and everything it includes puts all of the information in one place and helps keep me honest in tracking. It is also a great resource for all of the WW content and now, all of the recipes. (I have actually looked in my old cookbooks, and then checked the recipe database in the app, and every single one of them seems to be in the app. I could probably get rid of my WW cookbook collection, but don’t tell my husband I said that. 😍)

Long time member. The Weight Watchers App is amazing. It is more than a food or weight log and provides extensive information including healthy foods, mindset and behavior, exercise, support for those taking weight loss medications, access to nutritionists and access to the ever loved community via virtual workshops and Connect, their social media platform. I have been impressed by the steady improvement that this company has been making through the years adapting to scientific research and advances while making this information accessible to its users. I value the support that I have received through the years.

Improving but still needs work. My number one pet peeve is the search function. It is beyond me why when I start to type in a food, the suggestions that come up are not foods that I have saved or logged recently. It is maddening. For example, when I type in Premier Protein, it brings up 5 flavors ahead of the flavor I use on a regular basis and the only flavor I have favorited. When I type in a recipe name for a meal I ate yesterday, it can’t find it. Don’t most people eat leftovers? I don’t understand why I have to go to my profile to find favorites and recipes. Why isn’t it integrated in the search with a prioritized search on those items?

The Good and the Bad. I have been using this app now for several months, and overall, I’m quite happy with it. However, there are a few things that led me to cancel my membership. First of all, while the point system is a good idea, it does not translate into caloric intake reliably. I had days with many points left over shot my daily caloric goal, and days where I had no points left, and my calorie intake was way below what it should be.

Another thing that this app doesn’t do and really should is to track micro nutrients. Calories and points give you no idea how you are doing on the Trace minerals and vitamins that you need to stay healthy.

The daily range recommendations for the macro nutrients like carbohydrates, proteins, and fat do not take into account that different bodies metabolize different foods in different ways. For example, when I stayed within the recommended ranges, I did not lose weight. The weight loss happened when I reduced carbohydrates to be below what was recommended, and kept the fat recommendation slightly above the recommended numbers.

So while the system and app in itself is great for short-term weight loss, and does make tracking foods and what you eat easier, I do not think it is necessarily the healthiest choice for long-term weight maintenance.

Several years later when I was back to the weight I hated, a friend of mine informed me of a new meeting place that was right near where I worked. Back I went and got down to where I wanted to be in less than 6 months. I followed the app, went to meetings and tracked. Then Covid hit. The center closed again. While during that time I didn’t gain all the weight back it was enough that I was uncomfortable and didn’t fit right in my clothes. I am now back in the saddle again and having this tracking system is very helpful! Especially the scanner. The recipes are very good! Weight Watchers is not diet, it’s a way of life. If you follow it right, which really isn’t hard to do, between the app, the recipes and all the other support they offer, you will succeed for sure!
